art_instructions: Create a wide transition scene that shows the family cottage on the left and the small Greek village school on the right, under bright sunlight. In the left third, place the cozy cottage with creamy white walls, sage-green shutters, a terracotta tile roof, and a tiny front porch; sunflowers and lavender line a short cobblestone path by the garden. In the right third, place the white-washed school with blue wooden trim, a terracotta roof, and a small porch supported by wooden columns; include an olive tree, bougainvillea climbing a trellis, and a small stone bird bath near the entrance, plus a simple path-side sign that reads "ΣΧΟΛΗ". A curved cobblestone path runs from the cottage gate toward the school, clearly guiding the eye left-to-right. Midair above the path, slightly right of center and angled toward the school, the Owl (mottled brown-and-cream feathers) glides with wings fully spread and body tipped forward; her small green scarf flutters and a tiny satchel is slung across her chest. Her round amber eyes look ahead with a cheerful, focused expression; add short motion lines behind her to show flight toward the school. Keep the sun high with crisp shadows falling slightly to the right; include a couple of butterflies near the cottage garden and small birds near the school eaves, but make the Owl the largest figure, about one-fifth of the frame width. The horizon is low, and the view is a gentle high angle so both buildings and the connecting path are clearly visible in one scene.
